normative_extracts.quote: A parser is a function that consumes less-structured input and produces more-structured output, preserving type invariants in the return value.
JSON.parse() parses a JSON string and constructs the JavaScript value or object described by the string without runtime type guarantees.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Transforms untrusted unknown payloads at I/O boundaries into statically typed structures via single-pass schema parsing, isolating drift before UI render.

production_failures.symptom: App white-screens on boot for 12% of returning users after a deploy
production_failures.root_cause: Hydration called JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('prefs')) as Prefs; older stored objects lacked a newly required nested key.
production_failures.mitigation: Use schema.safeParse() at storage read boundaries and fall back to default state or run a migration when parsing fails.

production_failures.symptom: INP spikes above 220 ms when opening a 4,000-row data grid
production_failures.root_cause: Validating every row with deep Zod refinements synchronously on the main thread blocked layout and paint.
production_failures.mitigation: Parse large payloads inside a Web Worker or validate only the outer envelope and visible rows.
